notes.purposeZh: 小精灵系列的模块目录。与 metadata/metathinking/index.json 同结构、同 status 口径，因此 metadata/validate.js 可以用同一批 suite（S2 levelMap、S3 difficultyAxes）对撞两个系列，不必为小精灵另写校验逻辑。
notes.purposeEn: The MindSeeds module catalog. Same structure and same status vocabulary as metadata/metathinking/index.json, so metadata/validate.js can collide both series with the same suites (S2 levelMap, S3 difficultyAxes) instead of growing MindSeeds-specific validation logic.
notes.statusZh: status 取值：active 已上线并接线，校验器按最严口径对撞；in-progress 元数据已定稿但运行时还没接上，校验器把「找不到声明」降级为 INFO；retired 不再加载。
notes.statusEn: status values: active — shipped and wired, validated at full strictness; in-progress — metadata is finalised but the runtime is not wired yet, so the validator downgrades cannot-verify lines to INFO; retired — not loaded.
notes.scopeZh: 只登记已经有 levelMap 与难度轴声明的小精灵模块。games/ 下另外 1 个游戏还没有各自的模块文件，它们在 metadata/game.json 里有目录条目，但不参与 S2/S3——直到它们各自补上一份 levelMap 之前，代码侧应继续诚实地上报 gradeCode: null，而不是借用某个已上线模块的年级码。
notes.scopeEn: Only MindSeeds modules that already declare a levelMap and difficulty axes are listed. The other 1 games under games/ have catalog entries in metadata/game.json but do not take part in S2/S3 — until each gains its own levelMap, the code side should keep honestly reporting gradeCode: null rather than borrowing another shipped module's grade codes.

modules.statusNoteZh: 四个等级 K1-G2 全部上线并上报雷达（gradeCode 非 null，是小精灵系列第一个）。内容无静态题库，由 generator.js 按等级现生成，逐项由 games/difference-scout/test.html 审计。仍缺：G3 以上（应当靠增加属性通道或引入变换，而不是继续加格子）、puzzle 以外的运行时。
modules.statusNoteEn: All four grades K1-G2 are shipped and reporting to the radar with a non-null gradeCode, the first MindSeeds module to do so. There is no static bank: generator.js builds content per grade and games/difference-scout/test.html audits it item by item. Still missing: anything above G2 (which should come from more attribute channels or transformations rather than more slots), and any runtime other than puzzle.

modules.statusNoteZh: K1-G2 四级上线并上报雷达（原 G1-G3 的“带墙找路线”静态题库已移除，路线选择归策略大师）。现在是生成式的位置规律：荷叶跳、格子脚印、楼梯步、碰边反弹，动手点格子，选错展示整串脚印再重试。仍缺：转换规律（旋转/翻转）、格阵规律、解释规则。
modules.statusNoteEn: K1-G2 shipped and reporting to the radar (the old walled route-finding static bank, G1-G3, is gone; route choice belongs to Strategy Master). Now generated positional patterns: lily-pad hops, footprints on a grid, staircase steps, bouncing; tap cells, and a wrong try shows the whole trail before the retry. Still missing: transformation patterns (rotation/flip), grid-array patterns, explain-the-rule.

modules.statusNoteZh: K1-G2 四级上线并上报雷达。玩法已升级为动手放颜色：补全、预测（K2 起）、识别放错的颜色（G1 起），选错展示后果再重试；由 generator.js 现生成。这是规律猎手的样板，其余入口按它迁移。
modules.statusNoteEn: All four grades K1-G2 are shipped and reporting to the radar. Play is now hands-on: fill, predict (from K2) and spot the wrong colour (from G1); a wrong try shows its consequence before the retry. Generated by generator.js. This is the Pattern Hunter template the other entries will follow.

modules.statusNoteZh: K1-G2 四级上线并上报雷达。原先 4 个主题单元的静态题库改为按年级由 generator.js 现生成。仍缺：G3 以上、puzzle 以外的运行时。 玩法已升级为动手板：补全 / 预测 / 识别，选错展示后果再重试（共用 games/pattern-board.js）。
modules.statusNoteEn: K1-G2 shipped and reporting to the radar. The former static bank of four themed units is replaced by per-grade generation in generator.js. Still missing: G3 and above, and any runtime other than puzzle. Play is now a hands-on board (fill / predict / spot) that shows the consequence of a wrong try before the retry (shared games/pattern-board.js).

modules.statusNoteZh: 策略大师新模块，K1-G2 四级上线并上报雷达。先有原计划，到路口宣布变化，孩子判断坚持还是改变；约一半的题不需要改。由 generator.js 按年级现生成。仍缺：G3 以上、puzzle 以外的运行时。
modules.statusNoteEn: A new Strategy Master module, K1-G2 shipped and reporting to the radar. A plan comes first, a change is announced at the junction, and the child decides whether to keep or change; about half need no change. Generated per grade by generator.js. Still missing: G3 and above, and any runtime other than puzzle.

modules.statusNoteZh: 四个等级 K1-G2 上线并上报雷达。规则每题现编（数字按钮加带名称的效果），选错演示实际结果再重试；由 generator.js 按年级现生成。仍缺：G3 以上、puzzle 以外的运行时、规则中途改变的题型。
modules.statusNoteEn: All four grades K1-G2 are shipped and reporting to the radar. Rules are drawn per question (numbered buttons, named effects); a wrong choice shows the real outcome and the child retries; generated per grade by generator.js. Still missing: G3 and above, runtimes other than puzzle, and rules that change mid-question.
